old_C2_stage_bound.scope: 112 complete observer-free rank-local periods;3 typed target graph chains each, M24. From FP32 input cast and both512-wide projections through pool/ring update, normalization, index projection/quantized publication and final512-wide KV publication.
old_C2_stage_bound.interpretation: The entire union of these observed brackets is below the1%local-period screening threshold. Even eliminating the whole bracket is only a local exposure estimate under the assumption that surrounding work is unchanged. Real replacements retain substantial work. This is not an end-to-end speed ceiling or an algorithmic lower bound.
retained_open: Different workloads, material capacity effects, shared projections/gathers outside these brackets, or an independently priced cross-iteration mechanism may reopen work.
Existing native numeric, physical ring owner, last-reader, graph generation and all alternate-branch contracts remain valid obligations. Missing evidence is not independence or impossibility.

saved_native_work.overlap_assumption: Retain old task bodies, permit ideal concurrent update and RMS after pool, and require live page and readiness independence. Shared AIV/bandwidth, event overhead and later readers can reduce the overlap.

contracts.full_state_fusion: One feature tile per request reads and pools before its own writes. Keep the original stable per-channel ratio-2 arithmetic, BF16 completion and explicit zero for every other output row. Keep entire FP32 backing state in full mode. The original RMS and later cache/index readers remain.
contracts.valid_metadata: Use checked input dtype, contiguous device layout, nonnegative starts, used <= original max_query_len, and complete monotone token partition from base zero to T. A segment can have zero live rows or padding. Bound every row and retain the original host validations and unsupported branch paths. Empty output or empty request table can retain the original zero/early return.
contracts.physical_alias: Distinct positive valid pages suffice. A stronger proof compares per-slot reader/writer owner sets, computed once rather than pairwise per request. Same-page nonoverlap can qualify, while cross-owner WAR still occurs with disjoint writer sets. Multi-owner conflict or unknown alias uses the global pool-then-update path. Shared feature tiles have disjoint channel offsets.
contracts.compact: Only the previous even token can be read from old history in token-aligned ratio 2. Keep initialized same-owner state and monotonically advancing request starts. Three even slots admit retreat <=5. Four admit <=6. Tests compare every reachable next predecessor and original pooled outputs. With three slots and retreat 6, writing pos38 aliases old pos32 before a repeated odd start33.
contracts.retirement: The compact layout is a distinct state representation. Retire old generations and cover all readers before adoption. A fallback requiring the old state needs an explicit preserved bank or reconstruction. Do not count logical bytes as allocation savings while SWA still sets the tuple page size.

exact_SHA_native_ring_history.limits: Isolated finite input and owner horizon evidence. No new timing, actual live page-alias frequency, graph retirement, nonfinite suite, or end-to-end change.
exact_SHA_native_ring_history.qualification: Reuse bounded historical numerical/owner evidence. It does not admit arbitrary all-input full dual-sink fusion or replace current graph/alias/lifetime acceptance.

retention.bound: With R as a nonnegative upper bound on retreat from the preceding exclusive end, the smallest safe even-position modulo period is the smallest even P>R. Store ceil((R+1)/2) even rows per owner and use index (position//2) mod slots. Equivalence here assumes R<32 so the original period is also safe.
retention.guard: Unchanged logical owner, initialized state and serialized pool before update. Start is nondecreasing, each next start lies in [previous_end-R,previous_end], and missing, skipped or remapped pages are handled with their own predecessor state. No other observer may require original 32-slot contents. The original layout cannot be reconstructed from this reduced state after an unguarded fallback.
retention.proof: The sole old read is p=next_start-1 when next_start is odd. No earlier valid update ends after next_start+R under the guard. Any larger even alias is at least p+P, beyond those writes. A smaller alias cannot be rewritten after a write of p since the next start after that write is at least p+1-R. A write of p that falls outside the compact tail likewise cannot remain a required predecessor. Copy the live predecessor suffix with absolute tags when initializing or migrating an owner.
retention.async_use: For participating rows with six actual used positions, next_start=prev_gpu+valid_count. The saved seed path counts valid IDs among six entries. A guaranteed positive valid count implies R<=5. Allowing count zero implies R<=6. CPU/new/resume and full prefill transitions need their own horizon proof. No positive valid count is inferred from host shape.
retention.minimum_scope: If selection is deferred but none of these independent predecessor payloads can be reread or recomputed, all must stay available somewhere until acceptance selects one. A one-row persistent successor state moves this obligation into transient state; it does not erase the pre-commit alternatives.

projection_and_publication.contract: With valid live state the current full ring obligates all six projections regardless of publication. An even-only replacement always needs the three current even rows, plus each odd row whose completed endpoint is published. With all endpoints published it still needs all six. Compute actual publication as union of longKV and index slots, and preserve original transformed defaults for P minus C.

compact_history.qualification: Only predecessor-retention representation under explicit retreat/owner/reader guards. Full ring bytes remain observable until all consumers are closed; SWA can still determine allocated page size.
